verdict.rationale: Unit is a banking-infrastructure platform operated through its Dashboard and REST APIs. A natural-language command interface, such as an AI assistant or agent surface, is a plausible capability for this kind of product, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows Unit offers one. Its llms.txt file, OpenAPI spec and Postman collection are documentation and developer building blocks, not natural-language operation of the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
